name: Drag
summary: In Orgrimmar, the Drag links the Valley of Strength, Valley of Honor and Valley of Wisdom. Crafters and traders line its shaded red-rock canyon, where the descent to the Cleft of Shadow also lies.

sections.title: The Artisan's Thoroughfare
sections.body: The Drag runs between Orgrimmar’s red canyon walls, where crafters and traders fill the Horde capital’s streets. Unlike the Valley of Strength, with its military musters and commands, the Drag is where daily city life unfolds. High cliffs and hides shade the street, where tanning vats, alchemical cauldrons and tinkers’ gears fill the air with their sounds and smells. Craftsmen gather to practice their trades and teach aspiring adventurers. Their work ranges from leatherworking and tailoring to the goblin workshops of Nogg’s Machine Shop.

sections.title: A Crossroads of Shadows and Craft
sections.body: Merchant storefronts and salvage houses line the Drag, beside the guarded entrance to the underground Cleft of Shadow. The street brings honest tradesmen together with shamans on their way to the Valley of Wisdom and secretive practitioners of dark arts. They cross paths beneath the canyon’s dim, dusty overhangs.

faq.q: What is the Drag used for in Orgrimmar?
aliases: what shops are in the drag
faq.answer: The Drag is Orgrimmar’s main district for shopping and trade. Its trainers and supply vendors serve many professions, including alchemy, tailoring, leatherworking, skinning, enchanting and engineering, alongside general salvage and trade goods.

aliases: how to get to cleft of shadow
faq.answer: The Drag links the Valley of Strength in the south to the Valley of Honor in the northeast, with paths leading toward the Valley of Wisdom. The entrance to the shadowy caverns of the Cleft of Shadow lies along the Drag’s western cliffside.
Nogg is a goblin engineer who runs Nogg’s Machine Shop along the Drag. He trains engineers and supplies gadgets to members of the Horde.

faq.q: Are all profession trainers located in the Drag?
faq.answer: Most crafting and gathering professions have shops along the Drag’s lower and upper shelves, but the city’s blacksmiths and miners work in the fiery forges of the Valley of Honor.

angles.text: In the Drag, goblin tinkerers at Nogg’s Machine Shop teach schematics, explosives and specialized engineering knowledge to the Horde.
As a traveler through Orgrimmar, you pass along the Drag, which links the capital’s martial core to its communal and mystical quarters.
